analysis.analysis: The overall campaign shows a conversion rate of 12.26%, which is significantly above the industry benchmark of 1.4% to 2.5%. This indicates that the landing pages and conversion processes are functioning effectively. However, the customer acquisition cost is not provided directly, but we can infer that it is likely influenced by the cost per click across different channels. The cost per click for the channels varies, with some channels like SMS showing a very low cost per acquisition, while others like Facebook and Google Ads are higher. The return on advertising spend is also high at 7.94, suggesting that the overall campaign is generating substantial revenue relative to the amount spent. Therefore, while the conversion rate is strong, the varying costs across channels indicate potential inefficiencies in traffic acquisition costs. This suggests that the primary bottleneck may be in the pre-click phase, particularly in the ad creatives and targeting strategies used to attract traffic.
key_signals: Conversion Rate is 12.26%, significantly above the benchmark
Return on Advertising Spend is 7.94, indicating good revenue generation
detected_issues: High customer acquisition costs in certain channels
Variability in cost per click across channels
analysis.root_cause_hypothesis: The primary root cause is likely related to the pre-click phase, specifically the effectiveness of ad creatives and targeting strategies.
business_risks: Potential for increased costs if traffic acquisition strategies are not optimized
Risk of underperforming channels impacting overall campaign profitability

recommendations.title: Increase budget for SMS acquisition
recommendations.whats_happening: SMS has the lowest cost per acquisition and highest return on spend
evidence: SMS cost per acquisition is zero point eight three compared to campaign average of three point thirty seven
SMS return on spend is eighteen point seventy five, above all channels

what_you_should_do.step: Increase weekly SMS budget by twenty percent
what_you_should_do.how: shift twenty percent of budget from Facebook to SMS campaigns
guardrails: Daily SMS volume capped at ten thousand messages
Monitor opt-out rate below zero point five percent

recommendations.why_this_matters: More investment in the most efficient channel will lower overall customer acquisition cost and drive more new customers

expected_impact.explanation: Shifting spend to SMS reduces average acquisition cost due to its low cost per customer

dependency_or_risk: SMS subscriber list must be updated to include opt-in contacts
Higher volume may increase opt-out rates if guardrails are not followed

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare cost per acquisition for SMS before and after budget increase
measurement_plan.success_criteria: SMS cost per acquisition decreases or remains below one dollar
measurement_plan.check_timing: After two weeks of increased spend
measurement_plan.notes: Allow for one week of message delivery delay

recommendations.title: Scale email campaigns for new customers
recommendations.whats_happening: Email shows second best cost per acquisition and strong conversion rate
evidence: Email cost per acquisition is one point forty seven, well below campaign average of three point thirty seven
Email conversion rate is thirteen point thirty three percent, above all paid channels

what_you_should_do.step: Increase send volume by fifteen percent to high-engagement segments
what_you_should_do.how: target subscribers who opened at least one email in past month
guardrails: Maintain bounce rate below thirty five percent
Monitor unsubscribe rate below zero point seven percent

recommendations.why_this_matters: Scaling email to engaged users will add new customers at low cost and leverage a high-return channel

expected_impact.explanation: Reaching more engaged subscribers drives additional low-cost acquisitions

dependency_or_risk: Email list hygiene required to avoid high bounce
High send volume may affect deliverability if list not segmented

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare new customers acquired from email week over week
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Email new customers increase without bounce rate rising above thirty five percent
measurement_plan.notes: Exclude holiday periods due to atypical engagement

recommendations.title: Reduce Facebook spend and reallocate to efficient channels
recommendations.whats_happening: Facebook has the highest acquisition cost and lowest return on spend
evidence: Facebook cost per acquisition is four point forty, the highest among channels
Facebook return on spend is five point zero, the lowest

what_you_should_do.step: Cut thirty percent of Facebook budget
what_you_should_do.how: reduce daily budget by thirty percent and pause lowest performing ad sets
guardrails: Maintain at least eight thousand weekly reach
Do not drop below minimum daily spend of fifty dollars

what_you_should_do.step: Shift freed budget to SMS and email
what_you_should_do.how: allocate half of freed budget to SMS and half to email campaigns
guardrails: Follow guardrails for SMS and email scaling

recommendations.why_this_matters: Reducing spend on inefficient channel and shifting to top performers lowers overall acquisition cost and improves campaign profitability

expected_impact.explanation: Removing high-cost spend reduces average acquisition cost

dependency_or_risk: Facebook performance may rebound if new creatives are tested
Ensure budget shifts do not exceed channel capacity

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Monitor overall campaign cost per acquisition before and after budget shift

evidence: Instagram cost per acquisition is four point zero nine
Instagram click rate is four point four percent, below SMS and email rates

guardrails: Allocate no more than twenty percent of Instagram budget to tests
Pause any variation with click rate below five percent after one week

what_you_should_do.step: Launch A/B test with equal budget distribution
what_you_should_do.how: run each variation against current control for two weeks
guardrails: Keep audience and bid settings constant
Ensure at least ten thousand impressions per variation

recommendations.why_this_matters: Higher engagement ads will bring in more clicks at lower cost, reducing acquisition cost

expected_impact.explanation: Improved click engagement lowers cost per click and thus lowers cost per acquisition

dependency_or_risk: Creative production must meet brand guidelines
Low performing ads must be paused promptly

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare cost per acquisition and click rates across new variations vs control

evidence: Google cost per acquisition is three point nine
Google bounce rate is twenty four percent, higher than SMS and TikTok

Pause if unsubscribe spikes
